dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave spline following a sharp curve from the apex to the posterior insertion point at the dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Small pixel radius, categorized as rounded-acute at the highest morphological terminus.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep ascending slope, approximately 65-75 degrees relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis of the visible body segment.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 0.75:1 ratio of maximum base width to maximum vertical height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible depigmentation or scar tissue patch located at the posterior base of the fin; minor irregularities present on the lower trailing edge margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive high-contrast specular stippling (consistent with water spray or droplets) distributed across the entire visible dermal surface.
